DESCRIPTION: A stackable fire DOT. At the start of the affected creature's turn, each stack deals damage. Stacks decrease by 3 each turn.
Take 50% less damage. Entering a new stance draws 1 card. Entering the same stance exits it.
Deal 50% more damage, but take 50% more damage. Entering a new stance draws 1 card. Entering the same stance exits it.
Deal 200% more damage (triple total). Entering the same stance exits it. The pinnacle of combat artistry.
A stackable resource (max 15). Certain powerful attacks cost Gradient Charges to use.
